userStories.name: Correct TimeSeries downsample status documentation
userStories.description: Update the OSv2 status document so TimeSeries coverage reflects the shipped transform endpoint, server-side downsample pushdown, Timescale continuous aggregate path, VictoriaMetrics backend, and Vertex window aggregation surface instead of claiming there is no bucket aggregation or downsample capability.
bdd_acceptance: Given pkg/oss registers `/api/v2/ontologies/{ontologyApiName}/timeseries/transform` and the object TimeSeries routes, When an operator reads docs/PRD-Weave-OSv2-深度复刻-V2.md, Then the TimeSeries row no longer says there is no time-bucket aggregation or downsample path.

Given pkg/timeseries/downsample.go, pg_store.go, and vm_store.go implement DownsampleSpec/DownsamplePoints with avg/sum/min/max/count/first/last, Timescale `timeseries_cagg_5min`, and VictoriaMetrics query_range pushdown, When the status document describes TimeSeries storage and semantics, Then it names those live backends and keeps remaining gaps scoped to deeper OSv2 semantics such as calendar alignment, retention policy, and production tuning.

Given pkg/oss/handlers_timeseries_transform_us435_test.go and pkg/timeseries/us467_* tests cover pushdown and CAGG behavior, When the docs contract runs, Then stale claims about missing downsample or bucket aggregation fail until corrected.
